description: StorageDevice/StorageContainer error paths and async results against XNA 4.0, in an isolated data folder
script: goto:ct-storage;wait:30;press:Open the storage container;wait:5;press:Error paths and async results;wait:10;press:StorageDevice.DeleteContainer;wait:5;stats;quit
expectRegex: \[museum\]\[storage\] open the container: root .*/storage_contracts\.d/data/cna-3d-museum  connected yes
expect: ct-storage BeginShowSelector(callback, state): PASS
ct-storage BeginOpenContainer(name, callback, state): PASS
ct-storage CreateFile("../escape.sav"): PASS
ct-storage CreateFile("/tmp/absolute.sav"): PASS
ct-storage OpenFile("missing.sav", FileMode.Open): PASS
ct-storage DeleteFile("missing.sav"): PASS
ct-storage DeleteDirectory once it is empty: PASS
ct-storage Dispose twice: PASS
ct-storage DeleteContainer("../escape") (CNA keeps it inside the storage root): PASS
ct-storage EndShowSelector twice on one result: PASS (expected InvalidOperationException, got InvalidOperationException)
ct-storage BeginShowSelector(sizeInBytes -1, ...): PASS (expected ArgumentOutOfRangeException, got ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
ct-storage EndShowSelector(a BeginOpenContainer result): PASS (expected ArgumentNullException, got ArgumentNullException)
ct-storage EndOpenContainer(a BeginShowSelector result): PASS (expected ArgumentNullException, got ArgumentNullException)
ct-storage EndOpenContainer on another device than BeginOpenContainer's: PASS (expected ArgumentException, got ArgumentException)
ct-storage EndOpenContainer(BeginOpenContainer("")): PASS (expected ArgumentNullException, got ArgumentNullException)
ct-storage EndOpenContainer twice on one result: PASS (expected InvalidOperationException, got InvalidOperationException)
ct-storage CreateFile(""): PASS (expected ArgumentNullException, got ArgumentNullException)
ct-storage FileExists(""): PASS (expected ArgumentNullException, got ArgumentNullException)
ct-storage DeleteDirectory of a directory with a file in it: PASS (expected IOException, got IOException)
ct-storage FileExists after Dispose: PASS (expected ObjectDisposedException, got ObjectDisposedException)
ct-storage CreateFile after Dispose: PASS (expected ObjectDisposedException, got ObjectDisposedException)
ct-storage GetFileNames after Dispose: PASS (expected ObjectDisposedException, got ObjectDisposedException)
ct-storage EndOpenContainer on the right device after that refusal: PASS (expected InvalidOperationException, got InvalidOperationException)

replaceRegex.\\[museum\\]\\[storage\\] open the conta: \[museum\]\[storage\] open the container: root /cna-storage/cna-3d-museum  connected yes
